stem: Monoclonal antibodies can be used in the treatment of disease.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how monoclonal antibodies are produced using the hybridoma method.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Abciximab is a drug developed from a monoclonal antibody. Abciximab is used to prevent blood clotting in the coronary arteries in people with coronary heart disease.

Abciximab prevents blood clotting by stopping structures called platelets from binding together.

Fig. 6.1 shows platelets and abciximab in a coronary artery.

State the letter in Fig. 6.1 that represents:

• the target antigen for abciximab ..............

• the constant region of abciximab ..............

• one of the antigen binding sites of abciximab .............. .
